title: function-calling-parse-debug-scratchpad-maya-2
content:
Context:
- Investigating recurring parser failures when invoking function/tool calling on hosted API responses. Failures manifest as JSON decode errors in downstream services that expect strict function output. Seen in customer repros and internal load tests.

Summary of repro (simplified):
1) Chat completion request with function call and schema.
2) Receive streaming SSE chunks.
3) Concatenate chunks and call json.loads on final text.
4) json.loads raises JSONDecodeError or validation fails.

Observed behaviors:
- Intermittent (~1-3% under stress). More frequent with long outputs or Markdown/escaped content.
- Error classes: JSONDecodeError (Expecting value / Extra data / Unterminated string). Also cases where function payload becomes a double-encoded string.
- Streaming sometimes sends closing '}' then follows with metadata or garbage in same event, breaking strict parsers.

Representative payloads (redacted):
- Raw: '{\"action\": \"create_ticket\", \"params\": {\"title\": \"Login bug\", \"priority\": \"high\"}}\n--meta: token=abc123'
  -> json.loads: Extra data: line 1 column 79 (char 78)

- Truncated stream: '{\"action\": \"summarize\", \"params\": {\"text\": \"Long... (cut off)\"}'
  -> json.loads: Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 45 (char 44)

Local repro attempts and quick commands:
- Curl streaming test:
  curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-aug01\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"call func\"}],\"functions\":[{\"name\":\"create_ticket\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"object\"}}],\"stream\":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.loads(sys.stdin.read()))"
  -> intermittent JSONDecodeError.

- Python SSE client: collect event.data fields, join, json.loads. Added raw chunk logging and byte offsets.

Error traces captured:
- JSONDecodeError: Extra data: line 1 column 79 (char 78)
- JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 54 (char 53)
- Validation error: 'params' is string, expected object (double-encoded).

Hypotheses:
1) Server-side or proxy attaches metadata in same SSE event as JSON (no separator).
2) Model emits human-readable wrappers (e.g., "Here you go:\n```json\n{...}\n```") which must be stripped.
3) Double-encoding: function output serialized into a string field inside the outer JSON.
4) Truncation due to connection/stream interruption or client chunk reassembly bug.
5) Invisible characters (U+200B, smart quotes) or escape differences introduced in pipeline.

Small experiments and outcomes:
- Brace-extractor (find first '{' and last '}') recovers ~60% of Extra data cases but brittle for braces inside strings.
- json5 tolerant parser helps with trailing commas but not random suffixes.
- Stripping Markdown fences (```json) and leading 'Result:' reduces human-formatting failures.
- Instrumentation found rare case of metadata appended without SSE delimiter; filed server PR to enforce event separation (see linked PR).

Temporary mitigations in SDK/client:
- Robust extractor: slice between first '{' and last '}', attempt json.loads, log raw payload on failures.
- If payload has '```', strip fences and reparse.
- If schema expects object but got string, attempt json.loads on that string.

Action items (open):
- High priority: server-side fix to prevent appending non-event metadata in same SSE event (follow up on PR #987).
- Add server-side validation/linting for function responses; emit structured error events instead of noisy text when mismatch detected.
- Add unit/integration tests covering noisy outputs: markdown-wrapped JSON, trailing garbage, mid-token truncation.
- Implement stateful incremental JSON decoder client-side to detect complete object boundaries robustly (streaming parser/tokenizer approach).
- Persist raw SSE streams for customer repros to help postmortems.

Notes/todo for later:
- Scan failure logs for U+200B or other control chars.
- Test effect of temperature on incidence (higher temp => more chatter).
- Evaluate adding a small wrapper schema for function outputs (e.g., {\"__fc\": true, \"payload\": {...}}) to make extraction deterministic.
- Draft SDK README guidance: best-effort parsing steps (strip fences, brace extract, attempt double decode) and warnings about fragility.

References: RED-1234 (Linear), PR 987 (SSE separation), Confluence notes (linked).

-- maya (scratchpad)
